screenSummary.playArea: A shaded contour map with a probe, the level curve through it and its tangent, a unit direction arrow u and, when revealed, the gradient and its shadow on u.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose a surface, move the probe, turn u, reveal the gradient, or mark the critical points.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Predict the slope along u, then reveal it. Which direction is steepest, and which is level?

screenSummary.playArea: A 3D view of the surface with the probe, the slice of the surface along u, and that slice as a graph with its tangent.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose a surface, move the probe, turn u, and turn the view.
screenSummary.interactionHint: The slope of the slice at the probe is the directional derivative. Turn u to make it steepest.
